units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: б) conclusion of the contract under this Federal Law, automatically reduce the quantity specified under point 1(ж) of this paragraph in the preliminary offer of the participant with whom the contract was concluded by the quantity to be procured specified in the procurement notice under point 3(в) of this paragraph;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 9 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: в) posting of a record of evasion of conclusion of the contract under Article 51(6)(2)(а) of this Federal Law, or a record of refusal to conclude it under Article 31(11) of this Federal Law, release that participant’s quantity blocked under point 5(г) of this paragraph.
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 9 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 13. In procurement under paragraph 12 of this Article, information on all preliminary offers posted by participants on all electronic platforms must be accessible through information exchange with the unified information system. The Government of the Russian Federation shall establish requirements for that information exchange.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 14. In the cases specified in paragraph 1 of this Article, a contract may be concluded using the unified information system in the procedure established by paragraph 5(3) of this Article. In the cases specified in paragraph 1 of this Article, point 2 (except where the presidential decree or executive order or Government resolution or executive order provided for in paragraph 1(2) of this Article requires conclusion without the unified information system), and points 6, 6.1, 11, 12, 54 and 55, the contract shall be concluded in the procedure established by paragraph 5(3) of this Article. When a contract is concluded under this paragraph in the cases specified in paragraph 1(1), (8), (22) and (29) of this Article, the contracting authority may prepare the information and documents in the draft contract under Article 51(2)(1) of this Federal Law without using the unified information system, except for the contract price and procurement identification code. When information and documents on a contract concluded under paragraph 5(3) of this Article are entered in the register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities, and when that contract is performed, the provisions of this Federal Law concerning contracts concluded following an electronic procedure shall apply.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 15. Within the annual procurement volume and contract price limits established by paragraph 1(4), (5) and (28) and paragraph 12 of this Article, several contracts may be concluded for homogeneous or identical goods, works and/or services, including with the same supplier (contractor, service provider).
units.label: Part 15 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: § 7. Performance, amendment and termination of contracts
units.label: § 7. Performance, amendment and termination of contracts

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.label: Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: 1. Contract performance includes the following set of measures implemented after conclusion of the contract to achieve the procurement objectives through interaction between the contracting authority and the supplier (contractor, service provider) under civil legislation and this Federal Law, including:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: 1) acceptance of goods delivered, works performed (their results), services provided and individual stages of performance specified in the contract, including examination under this Federal Law of the goods, the results of works, services and individual stages of performance;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: 2) payment by the contracting authority to the supplier (contractor, service provider) for goods delivered, works performed (their results), services provided and individual stages of contract performance;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: 3) interaction between the contracting authority and the supplier (contractor, service provider) in performing, amending or terminating the contract under Article 95 of this Federal Law, applying liability measures and taking other action where either party breaches the contract terms.
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: 2. Under the contract terms, the supplier (contractor, service provider) must provide accurate information in good time on the progress of performance of its obligations, including difficulties encountered, and must deliver to the contracting authority by the contractual deadline the agreed results of supply of goods, performance of works or provision of services, and the results of an individual stage of performance. The contracting authority must arrange acceptance of those goods, works or services in accordance with this Article.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: 3. To verify whether the contractual results provided by the supplier (contractor, service provider) comply with the contract terms, the contracting authority must conduct an expert examination. It may examine the contractual results itself or engage experts or expert organizations under contracts concluded in accordance with this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: 4. Repealed. — Federal Law of 01.05.2019 No. 71-FZ.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: 4.1. The Government of the Russian Federation may determine cases in which goods delivered, works performed or services provided under a contract must be examined by experts or expert organizations.
units.label: Part 4.1 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: 5. To examine goods delivered, works performed or services provided, experts and expert organizations may request additional materials from the contracting authority and supplier (contractor, service provider) relating to the terms of performance and individual stages of the contract. If the examination reveals breaches of contract requirements that do not prevent acceptance of the goods, works or services, the opinion may contain proposals for remedying those breaches, including a time limit for doing so.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: 6. The contracting authority may decide to establish an acceptance commission of at least five persons to accept the goods delivered, work performed or services rendered and the results of a separate stage of contract performance. The commission may exercise its functions if at least fifty percent of its total membership participates in its meeting. A commission member's powers may not be delegated to another person.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: 7. The results of a separate stage of contract performance and the goods delivered, work performed or services rendered shall be accepted in the manner and within the time limits specified in the contract. Acceptance shall be recorded in an acceptance document signed by the contracting authority (where an acceptance commission is established, signed by all its members and approved by the contracting authority); alternatively, within the same time limits, the contracting authority shall send the supplier (contractor, service provider) a reasoned written refusal to sign that document. Where the contracting authority engages experts or expert organisations to conduct the said expert examination, when deciding whether to accept or refuse to accept the results of a separate stage of contract performance or the goods delivered, work performed or services rendered, the contracting authority and acceptance commission shall take account of the proposals recorded in the expert opinion by the experts or expert organisations engaged to conduct it.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: 7.1. Where the contracting authority requires security for warranty obligations, the acceptance document for goods delivered, work performed (its results) or services rendered, other than a separate stage of contract performance, shall be drawn up after the supplier (contractor, service provider) provides such security in accordance with this Federal Law, in the manner and within the time limits specified in the contract.
units.label: Part 7.1 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: 7.2. When a life-cycle contract is performed, the acceptance document for goods delivered or work performed (including, where necessary, the design of a capital construction facility or creation of goods to be produced as a result of the work) shall be drawn up after the supplier (contractor) provides, in accordance with this Federal Law and in the manner and within the time limits specified in the contract, security for performance of the part of the contract concerning subsequent maintenance, operation throughout the service life where necessary, repair and/or disposal of the goods delivered or the capital construction facility or goods created as a result of the work.
units.label: Part 7.2 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: 8. The contracting authority may refrain from refusing acceptance of the results of a separate stage of contract performance or of goods delivered, work performed or services rendered when they are found not to comply with the contract, if the non-compliance does not prevent their acceptance and has been remedied by the supplier (contractor, service provider).
units.label: Part 8 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: 9 - 12. Repealed. — Federal Law of 01.05.2019 No. 71-FZ.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 94 · “9 - 12. Repealed. — Federal Law of 01.05.2019 No. 71-FZ.”

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: 13. When performing a contract concluded following electronic procedures or closed electronic procedures (other than closed electronic procedures conducted by federal executive authorities responsible for developing and implementing State policy in defence, State protection, State administration in ensuring the security of the Russian Federation, and the activities of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, and by State institutions and State unitary enterprises subordinate to them, in the case specified in Article 24(11)(5) of this Federal Law):
units.label: Part 13 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: 1) within the period specified in the contract in accordance with Article 51(2)(1)(а) of this Federal Law, the supplier (contractor, service provider) shall use the unified information system to prepare an acceptance document, sign it with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorised to act on behalf of the supplier (contractor, service provider), and post it in that system. The document shall contain:
units.label: Point 1 Part 13 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: а) the procurement identification code, name and location of the contracting authority, name of the procurement object, place of delivery of goods, performance of work or provision of services, information on the supplier (contractor, service provider) specified in Article 43(1), subpoints а, г and е, of this Federal Law, and the unit of measurement of the goods delivered (where goods are procured, including those supplied to the contracting authority in performing the procured work or providing the procured services), work performed or services rendered, as included in the contract under Article 51(2)(1) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 13 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: б) the name of the goods delivered, work performed or services rendered;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 13 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: в) the country of origin of the goods delivered (where goods are procured, including those supplied to the contracting authority in performing the procured work or providing the procured services);
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 1 Part 13 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: г) information on the quantity of goods delivered (where goods are procured, including those supplied to the contracting authority in performing the procured work or providing the procured services);
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 1 Part 13 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: д) information on the volume of work performed or services rendered;
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 1 Part 13 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: е) the value of the contractual obligations performed by the supplier (contractor, service provider), specifying the unit price of goods delivered (where goods are procured, including those supplied to the contracting authority in performing the procured work or providing the procured services), work performed or services rendered;
units.label: Subpoint «е» Point 1 Part 13 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: ж) other information, taking account of the requirements established under Article 5(3) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «ж» Point 1 Part 13 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: 2) documents deemed integral parts of the acceptance document specified in point 1 of this paragraph may be attached to it. If information in the attachments differs from information in the acceptance document, the information specified in point 1 of this paragraph and contained in the acceptance document shall prevail;
units.label: Point 2 Part 13 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: 3) no later than one hour after being posted in the unified information system under point 1 of this paragraph, the acceptance document signed by the supplier (contractor, service provider) shall automatically be sent to the contracting authority through that system. The date on which the contracting authority receives the acceptance document signed by the supplier (contractor, service provider) shall be the date on which it is posted in the unified information system under this point, according to the time zone in which the contracting authority is located;
units.label: Point 3 Part 13 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: 4) within the period specified in the contract, but no later than twenty working days following the day of receipt of the acceptance document under point 3 of this paragraph, the contracting authority (unless an acceptance commission has been established under paragraph 6 of this Article) shall do one of the following:
units.label: Point 4 Part 13 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: а) sign the acceptance document with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorised to act on behalf of the contracting authority and post it in the unified information system;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 4 Part 13 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: б) use the unified information system to prepare a reasoned refusal to sign the acceptance document, specifying the reasons for refusal, sign it with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorised to act on behalf of the contracting authority, and post it in that system;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 4 Part 13 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: 5) if an acceptance commission is established under paragraph 6 of this Article, no later than twenty working days following the day on which the contracting authority receives the acceptance document under point 3 of this paragraph:
units.label: Point 5 Part 13 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: а) the members of the acceptance commission shall sign the received acceptance document with enhanced electronic signatures, or use the unified information system to prepare and sign with enhanced electronic signatures a reasoned refusal to sign it, specifying the reasons for refusal. If the acceptance commission includes members who are not employees of the contracting authority, the acceptance document may be signed, and the reasoned refusal to sign it may be prepared and signed, without using enhanced electronic signatures or the unified information system;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 5 Part 13 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: б) after the acceptance commission members sign the acceptance document or the reasoned refusal to sign it under subpoint а of this point, the contracting authority shall sign the acceptance document or reasoned refusal with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorised to act on its behalf and post them in the unified information system. If the commission members did not use enhanced electronic signatures and the unified information system under subpoint а of this point, the contracting authority shall attach electronic images of the paper documents signed by them;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 5 Part 13 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: 6) the acceptance document or reasoned refusal to sign it shall be sent automatically through the unified information system to the supplier (contractor, service provider) no later than one hour after being posted in that system under point 4, subpoints а and б, or point 5, subpoint б, of this paragraph. The date on which the supplier (contractor, service provider) receives the acceptance document or reasoned refusal shall be the date on which it is posted in the unified information system under this point, according to the time zone in which the supplier (contractor, service provider) is located;
units.label: Point 6 Part 13 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: 7) where the supplier (contractor, service provider) receives a reasoned refusal to sign the acceptance document under point 6 of this paragraph, it may eliminate the reasons stated in that refusal and send an acceptance document to the contracting authority in the procedure provided for in this paragraph;
units.label: Point 7 Part 13 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: 8) the date of acceptance of the goods delivered, work performed or services rendered shall be the date on which the acceptance document signed by the contracting authority is posted in the unified information system.
units.label: Point 8 Part 13 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: 14. An acceptance document drawn up under paragraph 13 of this Article shall be corrected by preparing a corrected acceptance document, signing it with the enhanced electronic signatures of the persons authorised to act on behalf of the supplier (contractor, service provider) and the contracting authority, and posting it in the unified information system.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: 15. In the cases specified in Article 103(5) of this Federal Law, the documents referred to in paragraphs 13 and 14 of this Article shall not be posted on the official website.
units.label: Part 15 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 94. Special rules for contract performance
units.text: 16. Where documents are exchanged in applying liability measures or taking other action because the supplier (contractor, service provider) or contracting authority has breached a contract concluded following electronic procedures or closed electronic procedures (other than closed electronic procedures conducted by federal executive authorities responsible for developing and implementing State policy in defence, State protection, State administration in ensuring the security of the Russian Federation, and the activities of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, and by State institutions and State unitary enterprises subordinate to them, in the case specified in Article 24(11)(5) of this Federal Law), the exchange shall take place through the unified information system by sending electronic notifications. Such notifications shall be prepared using the unified information system, signed with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorised to act on behalf of the contracting authority or supplier (contractor, service provider), and posted in that system without being posted on the official website.
units.label: Part 16 Art. 94

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.label: Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 1. Material terms of a contract may not be amended during its performance, except by agreement of the parties in the following cases:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 1) Repealed from 1 January 2022. — Federal Law of 02.07.2021 No. 360-FZ;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 1.1) where the contract price is reduced without changing the quantity of goods, volume of work or services, quality of the goods supplied, work performed or services rendered, or other terms specified in the contract;
units.label: Point 1.1 Part 1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 1.2) where, at the contracting authority's proposal, the quantity of goods, volume of work or volume of services specified in the contract is increased by no more than ten percent (except for a contract for construction, reconstruction, major repairs or demolition of a capital construction facility, site improvement, geological study of subsoil, or preservation of cultural heritage sites (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation), or the contractual quantity of goods supplied, volume of work performed or volume of services rendered is reduced by no more than ten percent. By agreement of the parties, taking account of Russian Federation budget legislation, the contract price may be increased once in proportion to the additional quantity of goods or volume of work or services, based on their unit price, but by no more than ten percent of the contract price. If the contractual quantity of goods or volume of work or services is reduced, the parties shall reduce the contract price based on the unit price. For this point, the unit price shall be the contract price divided by the contractual quantity of goods or volume of work or services. If a contract concluded following a competitive method, or under Article 93(1), point 24 or 25, of this Federal Law provides for several goods, works or services, the unit price for this point shall be determined by reducing the relevant unit price used by the contracting authority to determine the initial (maximum) contract price under this Federal Law, in proportion to the reduction of the initial (maximum) contract price offered by the supplier (contractor, service provider) during supplier (contractor, service provider) selection. If a contract with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), other than a contract concluded under Article 93(1), point 24 or 25, of this Federal Law, provides for several goods, works or services, this point shall use the unit price used by the contracting authority to determine, under this Federal Law, the price of the contract with that sole supplier (contractor, service provider). If the contract is for medicinal products, medical devices or consumables for them, the quantity of goods supplied and the contract price may be increased or reduced under this point by no more than thirty percent;
units.label: Point 1.2 Part 1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 1.3) where the volume and/or types of work are changed under a contract for construction, reconstruction, major repairs or demolition of a capital construction facility, site improvement, geological study of subsoil, or preservation of cultural heritage sites (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation, or under contracts specified in Article 34(16) and (16.1) of this Federal Law. Taking account of Russian Federation budget legislation, the contract price may be changed by no more than ten percent of the contract price;
units.label: Point 1.3 Part 1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 1.4) where the Government of the Russian Federation has adopted a decision to introduce special economic measures under Article 26.1(1) of Federal Law No. 61-FZ of 31 May 1996 On Defence, and the contract is for goods, work or services under the State defence order. At the proposal of contracting authorities that are federal executive authorities responsible for developing and implementing State policy in defence; civil defence and protection of the population and territories against natural and man-made emergencies; State protection; State administration in ensuring the security of the Russian Federation; or the activities of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, the contractual quantity of goods supplied or volume of work or services may be increased or reduced. The contract price may be changed, taking account of Russian Federation budget legislation and within the principal indicators of the State defence order, in proportion to the additional quantity of goods or volume of work or services, based on the contractual unit price. If the contractual quantity of goods supplied or volume of work or services is reduced, the parties shall reduce the contract price based on the unit price. The unit price of additional goods supplied, or of goods when the contractual quantity is reduced, shall be the original contract price divided by the contractual quantity of those goods;
units.label: Point 1.4 Part 1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 1.5) where, at the contracting authority's proposal, the maximum contract price (in the case specified in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law) is increased by no more than ten percent without changing the contractual unit price of goods, work or services or any other material terms of the contract;
units.label: Point 1.5 Part 1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 1.6) where the contractual goods, work or services are replaced by goods, work or services whose functional, technical, quality and operating characteristics are equivalent to or better than those specified in the description of the procurement object or in the terms of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider) (other than a contract in the cases specified in Article 93(1), points 24 and 25, of this Federal Law);
units.label: Point 1.6 Part 1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 1.7) where the contractual country of origin of goods is changed, subject to compliance with Article 14(4), point 1, subpoint в, point 2, subpoint б, and point 3, subpoint в, of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 1.7 Part 1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 1.8) where the details of the supplier's (contractor's, service provider's) account to which payment for goods delivered, work performed (its results) or services rendered is transferred are changed, without changing any other material terms of the contract;
units.label: Point 1.8 Part 1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 2) where the price of a contract concluded to meet federal needs for a term of at least three years equals or exceeds the price threshold set by the Government of the Russian Federation, and circumstances beyond the parties' control make performance impossible without amending its terms, those terms may be amended by decision of the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 3) where the price of a contract concluded to meet the needs of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation for a term of at least three years equals or exceeds the price threshold set by the Government of the Russian Federation, and circumstances beyond the parties' control make performance impossible without amending its terms, those terms may be amended by decision of that constituent entity's highest executive authority;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 4) where the price of a contract concluded to meet municipal needs for a term of at least one year equals or exceeds the price threshold set by the Government of the Russian Federation, and circumstances beyond the parties' control make performance impossible without amending its terms, those terms may be amended by decision of the local administration;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 5) where regulated prices (tariffs) for goods, work or services are changed in accordance with Russian Federation legislation;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 6) in the cases specified in Article 161(6) of the Budget Code of the Russian Federation, where the budget commitment limits previously communicated to the State or municipal contracting authority as a recipient of budget funds are reduced. During contract performance, the State or municipal contracting authority shall secure agreement on new contract terms, including its price and/or performance periods and/or the contractual quantity of goods or volume of work or services;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 7) where a contract is concluded with a foreign organisation for treatment of a citizen of the Russian Federation outside the Russian Federation, its price may be changed if the list of services related to that treatment is expanded or reduced on medical grounds;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 8) where, during performance of a contract concluded for at least one year under Article 34, paragraph 16 (provided that the life-cycle contract includes design, construction, reconstruction or major repairs of a capital construction facility) or paragraph 16.1, of this Federal Law, or a contract for construction, reconstruction, major repairs or demolition of a capital construction facility, geological study of subsoil or preservation of cultural heritage sites, whose price equals or exceeds the threshold or thresholds set by the Government of the Russian Federation, circumstances beyond the parties' control arise that make performance impossible, including a need to amend design documentation. An amendment under this point requires a written justification and a decision of the Government of the Russian Federation, the highest executive authority of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or the local administration, for federal, constituent-entity or municipal procurement respectively, and may not increase the performance period and/or contract price by more than thirty percent. That period shall exclude the time needed to obtain a positive expert opinion on the design documentation under Russian Federation legislation if it needs to be amended;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 9) where a contract under Article 34, paragraph 16 (provided that the life-cycle contract includes design, construction, reconstruction or major repairs of a capital construction facility) or paragraph 16.1, of this Federal Law, or a contract for construction, reconstruction, major repairs or demolition of a capital construction facility, geological study of subsoil or preservation of cultural heritage sites, is not performed within the contractual period because of circumstances beyond the parties' control that make performance impossible, including a need to amend design documentation, or through the contractor's fault, the performance period may be extended once by a period no longer than the performance period specified when the contract was concluded. If performance security was provided in cash, the parties shall agree a new period for the contracting authority to return that cash to the contractor. If failure to perform on time is the contractor's fault, the extension under this point is conditional on there being no outstanding claims against the contractor for penalties (fines or delay penalties) made by the contracting authority under this Federal Law, and on the contractor providing performance security under this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 95
